Raj (partnerships): Heads-up: KeyVaultX (HSM + managed KMS) wants a Redwood marketplace listing and coordinated launch. They asked for SSO via SAML, SCIM provisioning, KMS/HSM key-wrap integration, and a secrets connector. Proposed launch week: July 15. Who's in for a quick sync?
Elena (product): I'm available. We'll need a single demo path (console + API) and an embargo plan.
Tom (security): Ask for FIPS 140-3 or equivalent, attestation report, and explicit wrap-only policy. Also require that audit logs for wrap operations are accessible for our staging tenant.
KeyVaultX Rep: We have FIPS 140-3 cert and an attestation report. KMIP: kmip.keyvaultx.example.com:5696. REST wrap endpoint: https://kms.keyvaultx.example.com/v1/wrap. Support AES-KW and RSA-OAEP-256. We'll provide a staging tenant and credentials.
Megan (eng): For the connector we'll need a sample REST exchange and a small wrapper that demonstrates wrap/unwrap via our secrets API. Can KeyVaultX provide a sample curl?
KeyVaultX Rep: Sure. Sample curl for wrap: `curl -X POST "https://kms.keyvaultx.example.com/v1/wrap" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"key_id":"kvx/keys/abc","plaintext":"<base64>"}'`. We will also share KMIP script snippets.
DevX (devex): Please drop a short-lived service account + SCIM sandbox. We'll generate a SCIM mapping doc and some automated test users for the docs repo.
Raj (partnerships): Legal/marketing: what's the embargo? @LegalBot
LegalBot: Need signed MOU + partner quote approvals. Recommend 48-72 hour embargo after final asset signoff. Will post MOU template to shared drive.
Elena (product): Action list: 1) attestation + certs (KeyVaultX), 2) staging creds + SCIM sandbox (KeyVaultX), 3) SCIM mapping + sample payload (Megan/DevX), 4) MOU + embargo (LegalBot), 5) demo script + blog draft (Elena/Raj).
Megan (eng): Draft SCIM we plan to validate:
```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "alice@example.com",
  "name": {"givenName":"Alice","familyName":"Ng"},
  "active": true,
  "externalId": "u-7890",
  "x:device_id": "hsm-12ab",
  "groups": ["infra-team"]
}
```
Tom (security): Add MOU clause: partner must not permit unwrapped private key export and must allow log sampling for wrap ops in staging.
KeyVaultX Rep: Agreed on wrap-only and audit access for the staging tenant. We'll upload attestation + creds by EOD tomorrow.
DevX (devex): Created calendar hold: Wed Jul 3 11:00am PT for a 30m sync. calendar-bot: meeting scheduled.
calendar-bot: Meeting created: partnerships <> KeyVaultX onboarding  Wed Jul 3 11:00am PT. Zoom link in invite.
Raj (partnerships): Nice. Before sync: KeyVaultX drop docs/creds; LegalBot post MOU; DevX prep SCIM test users and a short runbook for console demo. We'll convert actions to tasks after the call. :white_check_mark:
